label: Talent calculator
description: Class calculator before a build has allocated any points.

label: Talent build
description: A shared class build with inferred spec and points per tree.

label: Hunter pet build
description: Pet calculators use one point total instead of three class trees.

label: Character history
description: Released Armory card showing stable history signals without choosing between healing and damage performance.

label: Character performance
description: Preserved performance-card design. Not selected by Chronicle until healing versus damage spec and metric selection is settled.

label: Guild activity fallback
description: Fallback for a guild with no logged boss kills in a recognized progression raid.
note: Current rule: shown only when no progression rows can be built. It shows estimated raid nights without player names or aggregate scores.

label: Guild progression
description: Guild card after at least one boss kill is logged in a recognized progression raid.
note: Current rule: any recognized progression boss kill selects this variant. It shows up to four of the furthest raids with kills.

label: Raid report
description: General raid report selected when the run does not qualify for a fast-clear card.
note: This is the normal instance-page card.

label: Ranked damage parse
description: One selected player and boss kill with a parse score of at least 75.
note: Selected when a share link contains one player and one boss kill.

label: Unranked damage
description: Player and boss share without a qualifying parse, led by DPS and raid position.
note: Used when no parse exists or the score is below 75.

label: Ranked healing parse
description: Healing shares switch the lead metric from DPS to HPS.

label: Realm-ranked clear
description: Qualified clear with an explicit realm rank and record delta.
note: Selected instead of the raid card when the time parse is 90 or higher.

label: Percentile clear
description: Qualified clear without a realm rank, using the time-parse percentile fallback.
